cmd_misc_dc_atlas_elsewhere_fix: put {dir} first on PATH, or remove {found}
cmd_misc_dc_atlas_missing: a new terminal does not find `atlas` ({dir} is not on its PATH)
cmd_misc_dc_host_silent: not answering ({why}); Atlas Desktop and `atlas dev` start it on demand
cmd_misc_dc_path_missing: {dir} is not on this shell's PATH (a new terminal may have it)
cmd_misc_dc_probe_failed: could not ask your login shell for its PATH ({why})
cmd_misc_dc_probe_failed_fix: open a new terminal and run: command -v atlas
cmd_misc_dev_runner_already: atlas runner already running (pid {pid}) · attach: atlas dev · stop: atlas down
cmd_misc_dev_runner_started: atlas runner started (pid {pid}) · attach: atlas dev · stop: atlas down

match.countExact=0, countPlural=*: Dry run: --fix would end no processes and free {size} (registered dirs and rotated logs).
match.countExact=*, countPlural=one: Dry run: --fix would end {count} process and free {size} (registered dirs and rotated logs).
match.countExact=*, countPlural=*: Dry run: --fix would end {count} processes and free {size} (registered dirs and rotated logs).

match.countPlural=one: --fix would also add a .metadata_never_index marker to {count} folder.
match.countPlural=*: --fix would also add a .metadata_never_index marker to {count} folders.

cmd_misc_doctor_dry_run_yours: target/, node_modules and worktrees are yours: they are never removed.
cmd_misc_doctor_env_unreadable:
Note: this OS cannot read another process's environment, so these are the processes Atlas
  saw under its terminals, services and actions while their owner ran. A process that forked and
  detached within about 2 s of starting was never seen and is not listed.

match.countPlural=one: Added a never-index marker to {count} folder.
match.countPlural=*: Added a never-index marker to {count} folders.

cmd_misc_doctor_indexed_heading: Indexed by Spotlight (rewritten constantly: mdworker/corespotlightd burn CPU and disk):

match.liveExact=0, livePlural=*: Orphaned processes: {orphans} (no process of live sessions left alone)
match.liveExact=*, livePlural=one: Orphaned processes: {orphans} ({live} process of live sessions left alone)
match.liveExact=*, livePlural=*: Orphaned processes: {orphans} ({live} processes of live sessions left alone)

cmd_misc_doctor_survivors: Still running after SIGKILL: {pids} (stuck in the kernel; they end when it lets go).
cmd_misc_down_timeout: atlas (pid {pid}) is still stopping after {secs}s; check: atlas dev --status
cmd_misc_heavy_ctx_join: cannot join the heavy queue in {dir}
cmd_misc_heavy_hold_anyway: heavy: {why} after {secs}s; running {label} anyway, timing-sensitive tests may flake
cmd_misc_heavy_interrupted_gates: heavy: interrupted while waiting for the machine ({label})
cmd_misc_heavy_queued_eta: heavy: {label} is queued ({ahead} ahead, ~{eta} to start)
cmd_misc_init_no_services: No services detected automatically. Edit atlas.yaml to add yours.
cmd_misc_mcp_not_dir: {path} is not a folder. Pass an existing project folder with --dir, or run `atlas mcp` inside the project.
cmd_misc_release_ctx_missing_asset: {tag} has no {asset} (download failed or missing asset)
cmd_misc_release_ctx_missing_signed: {missing}; signed releases only, refusing an unsigned install
cmd_misc_release_predates_signing: {tag} predates release signing: only its .sha256 (served by the same release) vouches for {asset}
cmd_misc_release_sig_invalid: {tag}: SHA256SUMS.sig does not verify; refusing to install

match.countExact=0, countPlural=*: atlas cache: hit {key} (no files, {ms} ms, saved {saved} ms)
match.countExact=*, countPlural=one: atlas cache: hit {key} ({count} file, {ms} ms, saved {saved} ms)
match.countExact=*, countPlural=*: atlas cache: hit {key} ({count} files, {ms} ms, saved {saved} ms)

cmd_misc_run_cache_not_stored_failed: atlas cache: not stored (the command failed)
cmd_misc_run_cache_not_stored_too_big: atlas cache: not stored (the result is larger than the cache cap)
cmd_misc_run_cache_store_failed: atlas cache: could not store the result: {error}
